intake-head-locating-dowel.title: The intake dowel locates the joint but does not clamp it
intake-head-locating-dowel.summary: The factory installation sequence puts the gasket and lower intake over a locating dowel. This reconstruction separates that positioning function from the still-unfinished manifold fasteners.

steps.title: Locate the intake gasket
steps.text: The applicable1994 installation sequence places the gasket over a locating dowel. Its clearance hole follows the pin datum without being a clamping feature.

steps.title: Locate the lower intake
steps.text: The manifold socket receives the projecting pin. This candidate assumes13mm head engagement,9.9mm intake engagement and separate blind bottoms; those depths are not Ford manufacturing dimensions.

steps.title: Keep the dimensional comparison explicit
steps.text: The1996 factory table lists a5/16 by1inch pin as part of the cylinder head. The7.9375 by25.4mm study replaces the earlier arbitrary envelope, but does not prove identical1994 hardware.

steps.title: Separate location from clamping
steps.text: A locating dowel cannot replace the manifold fasteners. The front lifting-eye attachment study and the fourteen other unresolved attachment stations are a separate scope.

troubleshooting.title: Do not confuse alignment with sealing
troubleshooting.text: A modeled aligned gasket does not demonstrate gasket compression or an airtight joint. The geometric checks cannot diagnose an actual intake leak or establish the correct replacement pin.

intake-head-locating-dowel.limits: Provisional comparison study. Pin diameter and length use an explicitly1996 comparison; station, socket fits and casting pads remain assumed. Clearance probes and connected solids do not establish1994 applicability, interference retention, production coolant-gallery compatibility, clamp load or sealing.
